additional_info.subject: ID0455612-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S11 314008598/001] Check Log files CRM:02889000738
additional_info.body:
Hello Rosita, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs and you are absolutely right, the customer authenticated with RFID and the session was not stopped.
Since this charger is in an outdated version, it might be a Firmware bug that we are not aware of.
I request from you an approval to update to v8.0.5, which is our latest version, and try to reproduce the issue.
If you do not allow the version to be updated, I can only request to reproduce the issue and see if it's reproducible.
Let me know what is best for you. Have a nice day :)
Best regards,
Francisco
